facts.fact: Morocco's CNDP took part in the work of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP), of which Morocco holds the permanent secretariat, at a meeting reported on 18 November 2026.

The first meeting of the new executive bureau of the African Network of Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP) was held in Rabat in September 2026, with Morocco holding the network's permanent secretariat.
